territories.name: Suriname
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Suriname levies a value added tax of its own under the Wet Belasting over de Toegevoegde Waarde 2022 (S.B. 2022 no. 121), administered by the Belastingdienst: article 2 imposes it on the supply of goods and services in Suriname and on imports, and article 4 sets a standard rate of 10 per cent, a reduced rate of 5 per cent and a higher rate of 25 per cent, with a zero rate for the supplies of Annex 1 and exemption, under article 5, for those of Annex 2.
